text:
leo (partnerships): Morning everyone — BalticCloud asked us to enable a Lithuania edge region (eu-lt1) in the marketplace and reserved pool. Can we call out blockers + who owns what?
inga (BalticCloud): Hi! We need an initial block of 2x H100-equivalent nodes (H100-2), marketplace listing, and a private-connect option for enterprise customers. Goal: soft launch in 5-7 weeks.
sam (eng-delivery): For delivery we'll need the exact instance SKUs and a sample deployment manifest so we can pre-warm model caches. Also want to confirm whether we can offer autoscale up to 8 nodes during peak.
roxanne (ops): Ops checklist: quota request to cloud provider, network peering, reserved IP ranges for private link, and monitoring hooks in Console. Please provide SKUs and expected qps.
pavel (infra): From infra: we need the container digest (sha256) for the runtime image, quantization profile to bake into the image, and whether partner requires NVLink across multiple GPUs. If KV cache must be persistent across AZs, call that out.
nora (legal): Legal asks: addendum for EU data residency, SOC2 scoping note for partner-managed nodes, and confirmation of SLA tiers for reserved capacity. Who is partner legal contact?
inga (BalticCloud): Partner legal is inga.legal@balticcloud.io. SKUs: BC-LT-H100-2, BC-LT-NODE-4TB. We can start with CMKs and evaluate HSM later. Also require token-level customer billing visibility.
leo (partnerships): Great — I'll collate. Action owners: roxanne open provider quota ticket (A), pavel confirm image digest + NVLink (B), nora send NDA + addendum template to BalticCloud legal (C), sam prepare prewarm manifest and scale test plan (D), tariq coordinate joint announcement timing (E).
tariq (marketing): Marketing needs 3 weeks lead time for PR and joint case study assets (partner logo, customer blurb). Prefer a co-branded blog and tweet kit.
integration-bot: Quota ticket created: https://cloudtickets.example/TKT-4572 (status: pending info).
roxanne (ops): Updating TKT-4572 with SKUs and initial capacity: 2 nodes reserved, burst to 8 nodes, expected peak 800 rps, sustained 200 rps. Adding private-link CIDR request.
pavel (infra): Uploaded runtime digest: sha256:9b3f2a1c7e4d5b0f6a2f1c3e4d5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3. NVLink: BalticCloud nodes do not expose full NVLink topology; we will validate fallback perf. KV persistence across AZs: recommended approach is local KV with cross-AZ replication disabled for latency reasons.
sam (eng-delivery): Drafting scale test plan. Quick snippet of the manifest we're testing: ```apiVersion: v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lt-infer
spec:
  replicas: 2
  resources:
    limits:
      nvidia.com/gpu: 2```
nora (legal): Sending addendum + minimal MSA redlines to inga.legal@balticcloud.io. Also flag: partner requested 12-month data retention exception for logs in Lithuania — need privacy review.
leo (partnerships): Noted. Privacy review slot booked with compliance on Thursday. 
tariq (marketing): Tentative launch window week 6. If legal & quotas sign off by end of week 2 we can hit that. Need logo + two-sentence case blurb by day 10.
inga (BalticCloud): We'll provide logo and blurb by EOD Friday. We'll also confirm whether HSM is required later.
roxanne (ops): Ops action: adding monitoring hooks and tracing config to the launch doc. Also requesting alert thresholds for partner SLOs.
pavel (infra): One risk: if NVLink is unavailable perf for multi-GPU loads may degrade ~15-25%. We'll run a canary with small model first.
sam (eng-delivery): Canary plan: 24h run with 10rps ramp, model small-bloom-1, compare p50/p95 to baseline. If perf drop >20% we fallback to single-GPU cluster.
leo (partnerships): OK — Huddle tomorrow 14:00 UTC to close actions. Summary of immediate next steps in the launch doc: - roxanne: finish quota ticket (due +2d) - pavel: confirm image & NVLink test (due +3d) - nora: send MSA/addendum (due +4d) - sam: canary plan ready (due +3d) - tariq: PR timeline draft (due +5d) Ping me with blockers. :rocket:
